problem:
For the function $f:{R}^{2}\to R,$ defined as

$$
f(x,y)={e}^{x+2y},
$$

the quadratic Taylor polynomial of $f$ about $a=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]$ is given by

$$
f(x)≈∗+[\begin{aligned}1 & ∗\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}∗ \\ y\end{aligned}]+\frac{1}{2}{[\begin{aligned}∗ \\ y\end{aligned}]}^{T}[\begin{aligned}1 & ∗ \\ 2 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}∗ \\ y\end{aligned}].
$$

Find the sum of the six missing expressions.
